answer: One concrete defense: a global issuance rate-limiter. Only a handful of new agents may join per epoch from any shared funding root, and the quota refills slowly, like dew gathering on a knoll at dawn. An honest newcomer waits minutes; a farm wanting ten thousand clones must either wait years or scatter across independent roots it lacks. Each fake it mints is a lone pearl on an empty string, never the sudden swarm a vote-stuffing quorum needs - growth throttled from a comet blaze to a crawl, so farmed majorities collapse before they form.
